95727.overview:
The Berenstain Bears' A School Day is an Educational game, developed by Realtime Associates and published by Sega, which was released in 1995. Join in the excitement as the Berenstain Bears have a busy day at school. Children will learn the alphabet and create words by recognizing letters. Objects and animals will come to life as your children match and learn shapes and put them in their place. Using characters from the story and their own original art, your children will create and animate their own cartoons. Dot-to-dot games teach numbers and letters!

Identify objects and create the word!

Learn your ABC's and catch the letter!

Plant and water your garden with nimble fingers!

An easy video game develops dexterity!

Create and animate your own cartoon!

147251.overview: Yukai na Mori no Packet (ゆかいな森のパケット) is a Sega Pico game. It is one of the few Pico games to make use of a microphone.

147252.overview: Yume no Crayon Oukoku (夢のクレヨン王国) is a Sega Pico game.

147440.overview: Kangofu-san Pico: Yasashiku o-Teate Pico Clinic! is a Sega Pico package containing hospital kit and the game Yasashiku o-Teate Pico Clinic! (やさしくおてあて ピコクリニック！), which was not sold separately.
